owner_request_2026_11_16_second.statement_summary: Custom lyrics source opening the file explorer with the widest format support, used and kept per title; app-wide background from the playing cover (off by default); better cover colours (purple/green results, colourful covers turning grey); Discord login kept across restarts and updates; experimental stem separation for AutoMix (fast vocals/instrumental and Demucs four stems, vocal transitions, instrumental first, bass swap, automatic use, background/charging, storage display and deletion, lighter option); add a whole album / several titles to a playlist. Screenshots of another app's stem settings were attached as reference.

done.custom_lyrics: CustomLyrics: OpenDocument picker from the lyrics sources sheet; content-detected LRC (multi-time lines, enhanced word tags), TTML, SRT, WebVTT, ASS/SSA with \k karaoke, YRC, JSON (Spotify-like lines, Musixmatch richsync, nested), plain text; UTF-8/UTF-16/Latin-1; 2 MB limit; copy kept in filesDir/custom-lyrics, per-title index, active flag; LyricsRepo uses it before downloads and online sources
done.cover_background: setting coverBackground (off): KetvoiceTheme dynamicTone = playing cover tone through artistPageTint (night cap and day floor kept), first colour immediate, then 900 ms glides
done.colours: CoverColors: 24 hue bins weighted by chroma and mid lightness, smoothed peak, average of the peak hue's own pixels; grey only under 5 % coloured pixels, then the most common grey; used by AlbumColors.dominant, CoverPalette.extract and CoverTone.dominant
done.discord: start() restored nothing: tokens were saved encrypted on linking but never read back; now the access token is set, and on refusal the refresh token is used before an interactive link
done.stems: real-time: Ketmix already had a centre-band vocal cut, a lyrics-timed voice-down and a bass swap; ketmixStems (off) adds instrumental-first entry released 0.3 s before the incoming voice (or at the swap / two thirds of the blend) and an outgoing voice-down ending when the incoming voice starts
done.playlists: PlaylistStore.addAll with PlaylistRules.newEntries (no duplicates); album pad button, library selection button, queue selection action; create-playlist dialog takes the pending titles

not_done.stored_stems_and_demucs: no stem files are computed, stored or listed, no Demucs model: on-device four-stem separation needs a neural model of tens to hundreds of MB and an inference runtime added to the app, with minutes of CPU per title; not attempted in this version. Background/charging-only processing, storage display, deletion and a lighter format therefore do not apply.
not_done.custom_lyrics_formats_not_read: binary or proprietary formats (KRC, QRC encrypted files, SMI/SAMI) are read as plain text or refused

known_limitations: Vocal separation is a real-time cut of the centre of the stereo image between 220 Hz and 4.5 kHz: it lowers lead vocals but is not a neural stem separation; voices panned wide or doubled keep part of their sound.
The incoming voice is timed from its lyrics; without timed lyrics it joins at the bass swap or two thirds into the blend.
A custom lyrics file is kept for one title (its id); another version of the same song needs its own file.
Ket 27 stays an alpha: several pages keep Ketvoice's own structure.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
